Workgroups

Monero is built by passionate volunteers worldwide. Workgroups are formed by community members who join forces to achieve common goals. Find your place and start contributing.

Just looking to chat?
Visit our Hangouts page to connect with the community.

Community Workgroup

The starting point for all new contributors.

Not sure where to begin? Join the Community Workgroup to meet fellow contributors, discover where your skills fit, and get guidance on your first contribution. Everyone is welcome!
